sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A sorcerer and the youngest twin in a family of heroes. Purus had always been sensitive to danger, and when he sensed that a very powerful demon awaited in the horizon, he warned his family to turn back, but none of them did. This forced him to muster what little courage he had in him as he prepared to join his family in battle. But the demon would prove too powerful for his family, and thus he borrowed power from his spirit friends to cast a large scale teleportation spell to help his family escape. However, having neglected his training in magic, his spell sent each family member to a different location, leaving them all scattered around the world.
